comment: layout_folder : folder containing the layout files (e.g. default.json, multi_dashboard.json) Depends on the project, vite is relative to /public, web server could be absolute path accessible by the server)

widget_definitions_folder : [optional] folder containing the widget definitions. If provided will use the given path to look for widget definitions. If not provided, will use `layout_folder's` value + `chosen layout name' to lookup instead.
